findings.title: Gateway listener's certificate Secret is missing or has no certificate
findings.cause: listener https of Gateway public (port 443, HTTPS) terminates TLS with Secret shop-tls, and there is no Secret shop-tls in namespace kd-gateway-tls-secret-missing, so the controller cannot serve the listener: HTTPS clients there get no answer, or a handshake error

evidence.what: Gateway public has listeners http (port 80, HTTP), https (port 443, HTTPS, shop.example.com)
evidence.command: kubectl get gateway public -n kd-gateway-tls-secret-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.listeners}'

evidence.what: there is no Secret shop-tls in namespace kd-gateway-tls-secret-missing
evidence.command: kubectl get secret shop-tls -n kd-gateway-tls-secret-missing -o jsonpath='{.type}'

findings.fix: Create Secret shop-tls in namespace kd-gateway-tls-secret-missing of type kubernetes.io/tls (kubectl create secret tls shop-tls --cert=... --key=... -n kd-gateway-tls-secret-missing), or have cert-manager issue it; or point the listener's certificateRefs at the Secret that holds the certificate.
